comment: What a picked icon value is, shared by src/lib/icon-picker/icon-value.ts (parseIconValue) and src-tauri/src/property_types.rs (valid_icon): `emoji:` plus exactly one emoji (one grapheme: a ZWJ sequence, a flag, a keycap or a skin-tone variant is one), or `icon:` plus a Hugeicons export name (an upper-case letter, letters and digits, ending in Icon, at most 64 characters). Both tests read this file.
